I bought/ ordered on line from www.vevor.se and everything went as smoothly as possible.With one exception:UPS carrier delivered my parcel to a wrong address/Local Pick Up Location and I was unable to get it. After a numerous exchange of mails with the Vevor and UPS I finnally discovered the whereabouts of my parcel.VEVOR behaved very proffessionally by reimbursing me the cost of my parcel and presenting all due excuses for the inconveniences caused by this incident. I highly recommend Vevor for its higly business manners and perfect clients managerial skills. Fewer words of appreciation I have towards UPS.

These standing floral arrangements look great and are perfect for events like weddings or parties. The 17.5" height gives them a nice presence without being too tall, making them ideal for aisle decor, chairs, or centerpieces. The orange flowers are vibrant and eye-catching, and the arrangements look full once set up. From a normal viewing distance, they look quite nice and add a warm, decorative touch to the space. They’re lightweight and easy to place wherever needed, which makes setup simple. The materials are more decorative than realistic up close, but they still look good for event use. Overall, these are a great option for adding color and style without the hassle of real flowers.
